summary: TCS is looking for an Infrastructure Automation Engineer in Bengaluru. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Python scripting and Ansible, as well as good understanding of infrastructure concepts.
responsibilities: Strong hands-on experience with Python scripting (automation, data parsing, file handling, APIs).
Hands-on experience with Ansible (playbooks, roles, variables, templates, handlers).
Good understanding of infrastructure concepts: servers, OS, networking basics (DNS, IP, ports), and storage.
Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows.
Ability to debug scripts and handle production issues.
required_skills: Strong hands-on experience with Python scripting
Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows
nice_to_have_skills: Nice-to-have skills are not specified in the job description.
